seo.title: Contact Grade Limited — request a stationery quote
seo.description: Tell us what you need and how many. Grade Limited replies to bulk stationery enquiries within one working day. Dhanmondi, Dhaka.

image.alt: A hand writing notes in a notebook at a desk

faqs.question: Do you supply wholesale to schools?
faqs.answer: Yes — schools are among our largest customers. Orders are quoted by the carton, with volume pricing from twenty cartons upward. Send your list and intake dates and we will come back within one working day.

faqs.question: What is the minimum order quantity?
faqs.answer: Most lines are quoted from one carton, and volume pricing begins at twenty cartons across an order. Mixed orders across ranges count toward the same total.

faqs.question: Do you offer custom branding on exercise books?
faqs.answer: Yes, on exercise books and files. Custom covers need longer lead times than stock lines, so tell us your intake date when you enquire.

faqs.question: Which areas do you deliver to?
faqs.answer: Dhaka and surrounding districts on our own schedule, and the rest of Bangladesh through freight partners. Delivery is confirmed with your quote.

faqs.question: How long does a quote take?
faqs.answer: One working day for stock lines. Custom branding or unusually large volumes may take longer, and we will tell you when you enquire rather than leaving you waiting.

form_sub: Include the item, the quantity and the date you need it by — that is enough for us to quote.
